step1_analysis.description: A macro-model of a full-duplex line driver for Gigabit Ethernet. It uses a bridge-like resistor network (R, R2) to cancel the transmitted signal at the receive node (VH), allowing simultaneous transmission and reception over the same line.

paper_reference.title: A Full-Duplex Line Driver for Gigabit Ethernet with Rail-to-Rail Class-AB Output Stage in 28nm CMOS

TX_Gain.description: Transmit transimpedance gain from IDAC to VLINE

sky130_expected.calculation: VLINE = IDAC * Z_in * Gain. With R=1k, Zin is approx 1k ohm. VLINE/IDAC = 1000 V/A.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the transimpedance of the input node and the amplifier gain.

Echo_Return_Loss.description: Isolation from transmit DAC to receive node (VH)

sky130_expected.calculation: Ideally -infinity dB if perfectly matched (VLINE = -VC, so VH = 0).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Measures how well the hybrid circuit cancels the TX signal at the RX node.

sky130_expected.calculation: Single-ended impedance should be 50 ohms to match the 100 ohm differential line.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Required for Gigabit Ethernet line matching to prevent reflections.

step3_testbench.description: Measures Transmit Gain and Echo Return Loss of the full-duplex line driver macro-model.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Full-Duplex Line Driver Testbench

* Amplifier Subcircuit (replaces generic A1 block)
.subckt amplifier in out
E1 int GND in GND -2
Rout int out 50
.ends

* DUT
IDAC VC GND DC 0 AC 1
X_A1 VC VLINE amplifier
R VC VH 1k
R2 VH VLINE 1k
RL VLINE GND 50
I2irx GND VLINE DC 0 AC 0

.control
ac dec 10 1 1G
let tx_gain = vdb(VLINE)
let echo_leakage = vdb(VH)

meas ac tx_gain_1M find tx_gain at=1Meg
meas ac echo_leakage_1M find echo_leakage at=1Meg

print tx_gain_1M echo_leakage_1M
quit
.endc
.end
